name: Highland
title: The Highlands —
tagline: Ben Nevis, Loch Ness, Skye and the open spaces that still draw millions of visitors.
summary: Highland is the largest council area in Scotland and the UK, covering the Highlands and a long stretch of north coast. It includes Ben Nevis, Britain's highest mountain, Loch Ness, the Isle of Skye and the Cairngorms.
After the Battle of Culloden in 1746 and the Clearances that followed, tens of thousands of Highlanders emigrated, and the diaspora in Canada, the US, Australia and New Zealand is huge.

community.intro: Descendants of Highlanders make up much of the Scottish diaspora, and clan societies in Canada, the US and Australia keep the connection strong.

ancestry: Searching for your family's roots? ScotlandsPeople, the Scottish Government's genealogy service, holds statutory registers of births, marriages and deaths, census returns and Old Parish Registers.
